description: Replace all datetime.utcnow() with datetime.now(timezone.utc) across the codebase, add Configuration Validation on Startup, and implement Graceful Shutdown Hooks
steps: Replace all 72 occurrences of datetime.utcnow() with datetime.now(timezone.utc) across src/nexus/. Files affected: main.py (1), demo/seed.py (4), governance/kill_switch_model.py (1), governance/persistent_kill_switch.py (2), governance/circuit_breaker_model.py (1), governance/persistent_circuit_breaker.py (4), runtime/heartbeat_service.py (3), and all model files in src/nexus/models/ (56 occurrences). Add 'from datetime import timezone' import where needed.

Create src/nexus/config_validator.py with a validate_config() async function that checks Settings on startup: warns about missing API keys (openai_api_key, anthropic_api_key), validates URLs (database_url format), checks Redis connectivity (non-blocking, just logs warning), checks writable data directories. Does NOT block startup - only logs warnings. Use standard logging module.
Integrate config_validator.py into the main.py lifespan startup by calling validate_config() early in the lifespan.

Enhance main.py lifespan shutdown section: flush telemetry metrics (call registry.reset() or equivalent), log Redis connection close attempt, persist ControlRegistry state if persistence is configured, log final status message. Ensure no data loss on SIGTERM.

Add tests: tests/test_config_validator.py for the config validation (mock settings), tests/test_graceful_shutdown.py for verifying shutdown hooks execute correctly, tests/test_utcnow_removal.py that scans source for any remaining datetime.utcnow() usage.
acceptance_criteria: Zero occurrences of datetime.utcnow() remain in src/nexus/
Config validator logs warnings for missing API keys without blocking startup
Graceful shutdown flushes telemetry and logs final status
All existing 2433 tests continue to pass (no regressions from datetime change)
